newsitem.title: IRAN: Tehran daily says Iran loser in Europe ties.
newsitem.headline: Tehran daily says Iran loser in Europe ties.

text.p: Iran's president-elect should forge closer ties with Asia and Africa rather than solely depend on Europe because Tehran was the loser in that relationship, an Iranian newspaper said on Saturday.

"At the surface level our foreign ministry envisages that it is the winner of the game. But at a deeper level we should have enough courage to accept that we have been the losers in this game (with Europe)," the English-language Tehran Times said.
The criticism appeared to urge president-elect Mohammad Khatami, who takes office in August, to change the country's foreign minister since 1981, Ali Akbar Velayati.
"While choosing his foreign minister, Khatami must bear in mind that too much dependence on Europe...is suicidal for a developing country like Iran," the newspaper said.

Khatami's foreign minister must work to expand ties with Africa and Asia which, unlike Europe, "do not force us to interwine trade with political or social issues. The residual colonial tendencies are still alive in the minds of certain leaders in Europe," it added.
Iran's "unbalanced reliance" on Europe has made it dependent on Europe for a large part of its foreign trade, which in turn is used as a tool to coerce the Islamic republic, the daily said.
